stories.title: Meet the LP: Keebeck Wealth Management
stories.description: The $2.5bn multi-family office has shied away from private equity’s mega-funds due to valuation and liquidity concerns, CEO Bruce K Lee tells PEI Private Equity.

stories.title: Centre Lane eyes $1bn Fund VI for complex mid-market situations
stories.description: Centre Lane Partners VI is expected to close later this year or in early 2027, according to Plymouth County Retirement Association board documents.

stories.title: Side Letter: COP out
stories.description: Compensation, value creation and physical risk frustration came to the fore at PEI Group's Responsible Investment Forum: Europe last week.

stories.title: Flexstone: LPs face more 'decision-making' in PE funds
stories.description: Investors are paying closer attention to a GP's use of CVs and NAV financing when considering re-ups, co-CIO and managing partner Nitin Gupta tells PEI Private Equity.

stories.title: Riverside Co taps longtime insider Joe Manning to run Riverside Micro-Cap Fund
stories.description: The 20-year Riverside veteran shares his vision for running the Riverside Micro-Cap Fund, which is now investing from a $1.87bn vehicle.

stories.title: Orange County to double down on co-invest following directs success
stories.description: The pension's private equity portfolio delivered a 41.3% net IRR this year following SpaceX's IPO.

stories.title: EnCap Flatrock targets $1.5bn for sixth midstream fund
stories.description: The firm previously raised larger midstream funds, including Fund IV, which closed on $3.25bn in 2018.

stories.title: Side Letter: CV red flags
stories.description: The implications for a poorly handled continuation fund can extend well beyond the transaction itself.

stories.title: Fundraising time on the road: The strategies and regions leading the pack
stories.description: Fundraising timelines are coming down for most strategies, though secondaries and larger vehicles have yet to return to pre-2023 levels.

stories.title: Soundcore preps for Q1 launch of Fund IV with $500m target
stories.description: Plans for the new fund come less than a year after Soundcore wrapped up capital raising for its $450m predecessor.

stories.title: Side Letter: Rainmakers beware
stories.description: LPs are heading into 2027 with diminished appetite for private equity.

stories.title: Charlesbank’s former CEO, current managing partner emeritus, resigns
stories.description: The leadership shift is happening as the mid-market firm seeks to raise its 11th fund, targeting $4bn.

stories.title: Aus performance test to include first alts benchmark
stories.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers unveiled a CPI-plus benchmark for ‘emerging assets,’ which could unlock further superfund investment in PE, VC and other unlisted asset classes.

stories.title: Side Letter: Anthropic acid test
stories.description: Anthropic's IPO could help validate aggressive marks; one of the world's busiest bourses seeks to further bolster its exit appeal.

stories.title: Alecta, Schroders weigh defense funds and risks
stories.description: Sweden’s biggest pension scheme and a large British asset manager are among those cautiously eyeing private equity strategies in defense and security.

stories.title: 'Don’t let retail get the leftovers,' StepStone warns
stories.description: As private markets open further to individuals, StepStone partner Michael Elio and fellow panelists at a recent conference say the big questions are access, transparency and whether the asset class can absorb trillions in new capital.

stories.title: Thoma Bravo establishes first APAC office in Hong Kong
stories.description: The tech giant already employs four staff in Hong Kong, mostly focused on investor relations.

stories.title: Side Letter: Pay-to-play peril
stories.description: More regulatory freedom could leave managers at risk from pay-to-play pitfalls.

stories.title: ILPA’s Choi: 'Retail' push raises exit management questions
stories.description: Institutional LPs could have concerns over investment horizons, fund size caps and co-investment allocations, according to ILPA’s CEO.

stories.title: Mubadala: AI an 'incredible opportunity' for consumer PE
stories.description: The sovereign wealth fund's recent acquisition of Chinese coffee giant Luckin is 'where the rubber has really hit the road,' consumer head Andrew Wang tells PEI Private Equity.
